source_metadata.title: Methodology for Determining the Correct Ultrasonic Pulse Velocity in Concrete

claims.assertion: The paper specifies kV=f(c;t;W;T) to correct measured ultrasonic pulse velocity.
The paper reports a 27-specimen 150 mm cube moisture/elevated temperature investigation and a separate 28-specimen low-temperature investigation; the experiments are not two independent papers.
The publication establishes an independently validated universal relationship that predicts compressive strength solely from corrected UPV.
